title: 第一卷 第13章 开了运气挂？
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
李华走得快。

    动静也不小。

    礁石边上的青蟹可能是察觉到危险，挥舞着大钳子，同时身子赶紧往礁石下面的缝隙躲。

    结果。

    顾头不顾尾。

    李华弯下腰，伸手从礁石另一面直接从后面抓住青蟹，哗啦一声直接从水里拎出来。

    被抓住的青蟹，挥舞着大钳子，已经是瓮中之蟹。

    阿青看到。

    激动的喊道：“哥，你真厉害，一下就抓住了。”

    他伸出大拇指。

    离得近。

    青蟹的钳子下意识夹过去。

    阿青吓了一跳，这要是被夹住可不得了，手指头都可能直接被夹断，村里就有人赶海的时候不小心被青蟹夹住。

    然后，那手指头就掉在海水里，海浪打过来，找都找不到了。

    李华也挺高兴，三两下用绳子绑起来扔进往兜里，说道：“还是母蟹。”

    “开门红。”

    “阿青，看你右脚。”

    阿青低头一看，很快抓到一个八爪鱼出来：“哥，你眼力太强了，我都没注意到。”

    李华：“仔细看。”

    他回头看向张春妮：“你也是。”

    张春妮点点头。

    很快。

    她也有发现。

    可搬不动石头，她用尽全力，也只能把石头给推的晃动，藏在礁石缝隙之中的螃蟹，挥舞着钳子，像是在挑衅她。

    美女，你行不行啊？

    来抓我啊？

    李华走过来，把礁石给挪开。

    张春妮愣了一下，赶紧用火钳把螃蟹给夹住，是个石头蟹，这玩意卖不出钱，但能吃。

    李华就挺喜欢吃，煮了就是很不错的下酒菜。

    张春妮把石头蟹扔水桶里，低声道：“谢谢。”

    李华又伸手摸了摸，抓出来一只斑节虾。

    斑节虾好看又好吃，身上有很漂亮的纹路，吃煮了吃起来口感弹牙，肉质鲜美，是抢手货。

    价格也相当不错。

    李华又走了几步，抓到两只石头蟹，个头还不小，阿青看的羡慕不已：“哥，你太厉害了。”

    “走一步就有收获。”

    “我怎么都抓不到。”

    他有些着急。

    再这么下去，他可就拖后腿了。

    李华说道：“找有石头有水的小水洼。”

    潮水退却，小鱼小虾会来不及跟着潮水退回大海，就只能在小水洼活动等待涨潮，这都是最基本的常识。

    阿青不懂。
content_en:
Li Hua walked fast.

    The movement is not small either.

    The blue crabs on the edge of the reef may have sensed the danger, waving their large pincers, and at the same time hurriedly hid in the gap under the reef.

    result.

    Pay attention to the beginning and not the end.

    Li Hua bent down, reached out from the other side of the reef, grabbed the blue crab from behind, and lifted it out of the water with a splash.

    The caught blue crab, waving its big pincers, is already a crab in a jar.

    Ah Qing saw it.

    He shouted excitedly: "Brother, you are so amazing, you caught me right away."

    He held out his thumb.

    Close.

    The blue crab's pincers subconsciously pinched it.

    Ah Qing was startled. If he got caught, it would be serious. His fingers might be cut off. Someone in the village accidentally got caught by a blue crab while rushing to the sea.

    Then, the finger fell into the sea water, and the waves came over and couldn't find it.

    Li Hua was also very happy. He tied it up with a rope and threw it into his pocket, saying, "It's still a female crab."

    "A good start."

    "Aqing, look at your right foot."

    Ah Qing looked down and quickly caught an octopus and said, "Brother, your eyesight is so strong that I didn't even notice it."

    Li Hua: "Look carefully."

    He looked back at Zhang Chuni: "You too."

    Zhang Chunni nodded.

    soon.

    She also made a discovery.

    But she couldn't move the stone. She tried her best and could only push the stone to shake. The crab hiding in the cracks of the reef waved its pincers as if to provoke her.

    Beauty, can you do it?

    Come and catch me?

    Li Hua came over and moved the rocks away.

    Zhang Chunni was stunned for a moment, and quickly caught the crab with tongs. It was a stone crab. You can't sell it for money, but you can eat it.

    Li Hua likes to eat it very much. When cooked, it is a very good dish to go with wine.

    Zhang Chunni threw the stone crab into the bucket and whispered: "Thank you."

    Li Hua reached out and touched again and caught out a monodon shrimp.

    Monodon shrimps are good-looking and delicious. They have beautiful lines on their bodies. They taste springy when cooked and their meat is delicious. They are a popular commodity.

    The price is pretty good too.

    Li Hua walked a few more steps and caught two stone crabs. They were quite big. Ah Qing looked envious: "Brother, you are so awesome."

    “Every step you take leads to rewards.”

    "I can't catch it no matter what."

    He was a little anxious.

    If this continues, he will be held back.

    Li Hua said: "Look for a small puddle with rocks and water."

    When the tide recedes, small fish and shrimps will not have time to follow the tide back to the sea, so they can only move around in small puddles and wait for the rising tide. This is the most basic common sense.

    Ah Qing doesn’t understand.
